##### alarm()

```ts
alarm(): Promise<void>;
```

Native alarms reconstruct the owner without an incoming user request. A
construction or wake failure must not strand the claimed work on platform alarm
retries: it is caught, logged, and explicitly re-armed with bounded backoff
instead.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`void`\>

## Functions

### deliverSessionGrantsToStorage()

```ts
function deliverSessionGrantsToStorage(
  storage,
  sessionId,
  delivery,
): GrantsDeliveryResult;
```

Deliver one Session's grants into a Cloudflare owner's own storage,
synchronously, whether or not its runtime is open; the very next tool call reads
it. A plain function, not a Durable Object method, so no other Durable Object
can call it over RPC: only code running inside the owner, holding its storage,
delivers grants.

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                        |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `storage`   | [`SqliteOwner`](index.md#sqliteowner)       |
| `sessionId` | `string`                                    |
| `delivery`  | [`GrantsDelivery`](index.md#grantsdelivery) |

#### Returns

[`GrantsDeliveryResult`](index.md#grantsdeliveryresult)
